name: Muse Sentinel
description: Asks the owner on their phone before the agent does anything that leaves the machine: sending, posting, submitting forms, booking, buying or deleting.

telegram.description: Numeric Telegram user ids allowed to approve actions.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp numbers in E.164 form (+420123456789) allowed to approve actions.

telegram.description: Telegram chat id that receives approval prompts (default: first Telegram owner).

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number that receives approval prompts (default: first WhatsApp owner).

guardModel.description: Anthropic model that judges unclear browser actions (default: claude-haiku-5-5).

approvalTtlMinutes.description: How long an approval request stays open (default: 30).

mode.description: outbound: ask before anything that leaves the machine. money: ask only for payments and purchases. off: allow everything except the always-denied tools.

owners.label: Owners
owners.help: Telegram user ids and WhatsApp numbers whose /ok and /no replies count as approvals.

notify.label: Notify
notify.help: Where approval prompts are sent. Defaults to the first owner on each channel.

guardModel.label: Guard model
guardModel.help: Separate model that judges unclear browser actions. Uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
